descriptions.notStarted: Looks like Jonas fixed the machine... yet it's still cranking out these crazy toys.  Maybe he is bonkers.  Or maybe he needs some more help.
descriptions.inProgress: Looks like Jonas needs help building a new doll, a more perfect likeness of Sophilia.  I don't think he realizes she's dead.  In any case, I have to collect #b30 Locks of Doll's Hair, 10 Heartstoppers, 10 Maple Candies, and 10 Pumpkin Taffies#k.  Why the candies?  I may never know...
descriptions.completed: I collected everything Jonas needed to build his new doll in the likeness of his daughter.  I have to say though... it looks nothing like her.
